question: Do the official 2024 and 2026 Nagao Foundation field-project reports provide release-ready species occurrences for Luzon freshwater and estuarine waters?

sourcesReviewed.citation: Nagao Natural Environment Foundation, Maeda research team. (2024). Freshwater and estuarine fish fauna of the Philippines: 2024 preliminary survey report. Official project report.
sourcesReviewed.access: Full nine-page report and the Foundation project page were reviewed. The report describes the preliminary field trip as 21 November–1 December 2024; the project page summarizes it as 22–30 November 2024.

reportedScope.activities: Institutional and local-government consultations, prospective-site visits, observations, preliminary water sampling for eDNA at the Cabayugan River cave inflow, and limited exploratory collection/field work. It is not presented as a standardized inventory.

selectedSourceReportedObservations.context: A report caption identifies a school of dwarf gobies at an unused fishpond/mangrove-swamp area on the Western Philippines University Puerto Princesa Campus.
selectedSourceReportedObservations.precision: Campus-level habitat label; no coordinates, specimen/voucher number, or individual event crosswalk in the report.

selectedSourceReportedObservations.context: A caption identifies a Rhinogobius larva found in a stream in Ilocos Norte.
selectedSourceReportedObservations.precision: Genus-level only; stream/reach unnamed and no coordinates or voucher crosswalk.

selectedSourceReportedObservations.context: Several fish were observed in the upper Cabayugan River; the report does not identify them. Water was sampled at the river/cave inflow for preliminary eDNA work, but this report gives no assay results.
selectedSourceReportedObservations.precision: Named river and broad reach context only; no coordinates or published eDNA detections.

limits: The 2024 report is principally a feasibility/scoping and site-visit account, not a complete species checklist or station-by-taxon survey dataset.
The official project page and report give different field-trip date ranges; preserve both and do not invent a single exact duration.
Observations, captions, attempted collecting, local fishery context and preliminary environmental-DNA sampling are different evidence types; no eDNA result is reported here.
No complete field-method/effort table, coordinates, specimen collection numbers, or public sample-to-site crosswalk was found.

sourcesReviewed.citation: Nagao Natural Environment Foundation, Maeda research team. (2026-02-27). Report on survey on Luzon, Philippines. Official project report.
sourcesReviewed.access: Full 15-page report and Foundation project update page were reviewed. The report states field work was conducted 26 January–13 February 2026 in Cagayan, Ilocos Norte and Metro Manila.

reportedScope.habitatsAndActivities: The team reports sampling rivers and tributaries near Tuguegarao, streams, small coastal rivers, estuaries and fishpond-associated waters in Cagayan; it also reports a market-specimen component in Aparri and neighboring towns. In Ilocos Norte it reports sampling one freshwater river site and an estuary during a short field window. Museum and laboratory collections were examined in Metro Manila.

selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.context: The report says this fish was observed in Cagayan and that collected material would be examined for taxonomy, phylogeny, coloration and distribution.
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.precision: Province-level label; the exact river/reach, field date per individual and specimen catalog accession are not supplied in the report.

selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.context: A caption identifies this genus-level fish in a creek associated with the MMSU Currimao Campus fishpond.
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.precision: Campus/creek association only; no coordinates or specimen catalog number.

selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.context: The report describes larvae of this genus ascending in schools in lower river reaches and discusses them as a likely component of ipon.
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.precision: Genus-level, broad lower-reach context; no named river, station, or species identification.

selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.verbatimTaxon: Oreochromis sp.; Barbonymus sp.; Trichogaster trichopterus; Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus; guppy
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.context: The report mentions these labels in its Cagayan field/catch discussion; it distinguishes local fishing, observed fish and collected specimens in different passages.
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.precision: Not a complete station-by-taxon table; evidence type and exact site vary or are not fully crosswalked. Preserve the report's wording pending specimen-level verification.

selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.context: The report names this as the river-mullet research taxon and describes another otolith-sample set being found after planned frozen samples were lost.
selectedSourceReportedTaxaAndContext.precision: The report does not publish a 2026 site-specific Ludong specimen/accession table. The name conflicts with the 2022 NFRDI COI result Cestraeus goldiei; do not silently merge.

limits: Although actual sampling is reported, the report does not publish a complete station register, coordinates, named reaches for all samples, catalog numbers, full taxon list, or machine-readable sample-to-site table.
Market specimens, local fishery observations, field sightings, and wild-collected specimens are not interchangeable occurrence evidence.
The report states that a rare endemic fish was found in Ilocos Norte but does not identify it in the text reviewed; do not guess the species.
It relays a suspected poisoning/electrofishing cause for dead gobies but explicitly says the specific cause is unknown; this is unverified hearsay, not a mortality or enforcement finding.
The report provides no exact taxon-by-date-by-site record suitable for a public map, and its page-level copyright does not provide an item-specific reuse license.

crossSourceAssessment.surveyContinuity: The 2026 report follows the 2024 site-scoping trip, describing repeat visits in parts of Cagayan and Ilocos Norte and broader sampling. It is a project continuity link, not independent replication.
crossSourceAssessment.taxonomicConflict: The project reports call Ludong Cestraeus plicatilis, while Escaño et al. (2022) report their analyzed Cagayan/Abra COI sequences as Cestraeus goldiei. Resolve against voucher-linked diagnostics and current taxonomic review; do not merge names or locations on vernacular name alone.
crossSourceAssessment.habitatCoverage: The reports explicitly cover inland rivers, tributaries and streams as well as estuaries, mangrove/fishpond-associated brackish habitat, market specimens, and collection visits. They do not provide a full survey of Luzon's lakes, reservoirs, all river basins, or marine-coastal fish fauna.
crossSourceAssessment.appReadiness: Useful as research and future-data-release leads only. They do not establish completeness, current range, abundance, diet, catchability, safety, legal fishing access, or verified geometry.

rightsReview.status: No item-specific reuse license was identified for either report during this review.
rightsReview.handling: No PDF, image, table, map, or underlying sample data were copied into the repository. Metadata and short factual research notes only.

disposition.reason: The reports provide valuable inland-water and estuary sampling leads, but no complete station/taxon/voucher crosswalk or item-specific reuse license; one key Ludong taxon label conflicts with the independent 2022 NFRDI molecular report.

nextAction: Review the official April 2026 Palawan field report next, then maintain a single source-to-station request checklist for this project: exact sampling coordinates/reach and dates, collection vs market vs observation category, voucher/accession catalogue, diagnostic determination, underlying checklist/data release, and reuse terms. Continue other Luzon river, lake, reservoir and estuary regions in parallel; do not mark any region complete based on these project reports.

sources.supports: Full 2024 preliminary survey report, dates printed in the report, regions visited, selected caption-level observations, and described scoping activities.
Full 2026 Luzon survey report, stated sampling dates, habitat types, broad regional work, selected report-named taxa, sampling limitations, and the authors' unresolved statements.
Official project page with project scope, 2024 update date range, linked reports and published project deliverable status.
Independent 2022 NFRDI ludong COI study record used only to document the differing source taxon name; it is not independent confirmation of the 2024/2026 project observations.
